card.name: Words completing stock warning phrases
card.fires_on: The word just before a fixed warning phrase finishes: 'to' in 'inflammatory response to indolent or residual opportunistic infections', 'blood' in 'occult or gross blood loss', and 'normal' in 'than those with normal function'.

modes.label: Immune reconstitution wording
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'inflammatory response' in the antiretroviral immune reconstitution warning.
modes.example: patients whose immune systems respond may develop an inflammatory response<< to>> indolent or residual opportunistic infections

modes.label: Anemia cause wording
modes.description: The word 'blood' after 'occult or gross' in the NSAID hematologic toxicity warning.
modes.example: This may be due to occult or gross<< blood>> loss, fluid retention, or an incom

modes.label: Hepatic impairment comparison
modes.description: The word 'normal' after 'than those with' in the hepatic impairment dosing text.
modes.example: may have higher plasma concentrations of hydrocodone than those with<< normal>> function. Initiate therapy with one half
